learning_outcomes.text: Express and communicate ideas and systems related to thermal energy transmission.
Propose heat transfer systems and apply them to the calculation and design of heat exchangers.
Master the calculations and procedures for estimation and design in heat production matters, both in domestic and industrial settings.
Understand and prepare professional technical documentation on energy technology topics.

syllabus_topics: Topic 1. Introduction and Basic Concepts of Heat Transfer
Topic 8. Natural Convection and Phase Change
Practice 2: Heat Conduction (Case Study Resolution, Classroom)
Practice 3: Transient Regime (Case Study Resolution, Classroom)
Practice 5: Types of Heat Exchangers (Description and Analysis, Workshop)

assessment_methods.method: Exams. Long and short answer tests including problem-solving and evaluation of theoretical concepts
Resolution of practical cases, preparation of reports, laboratory practices

assessment_rules: The final grade will be the weighted average of all activities. To pass the course, a grade of 5 or higher (out of 10) is required, in addition to meeting the minimum required grade of 4.5 for exams. Students who fail may pass the course in the resit exam, in which case the final grade will be the grade from this exam.
